questions.content: Two dice are thrown independently. Let be the event that the number appeared on the die is less than the number appeared on the die, be the event that the number appeared on the die is even and that on the second die is odd, and be the event that the number appeared on the die is odd and that on the is even. Then :

options.content: A and B are mutually exclusive
the number of favourable cases of the events A, B and C are 15, 6 and 6 respectively
